name: @cntryl/website
description: Cntryl marketing and product documentation site

scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:ssg
scripts.lint: vp lint src scripts tests ssg.config.ts vite.config.ts
scripts.fmt: vp fmt src scripts tests ssg.config.ts vite.config.ts index.html package.json tsconfig.json README.md
scripts.fmt:check: vp fmt src scripts tests ssg.config.ts vite.config.ts index.html package.json tsconfig.json README.md --check
scripts.check: npm run fmt:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run build && npm run verify:static
